description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the EmployeeCountAPI class in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various methods such as getAll(), handling of validation rules, and interactions with the EmployeeService mock. The tests confirm the behavior of the API endpoint to retrieve employee count data with different filtering parameters.
